workflow_runs.display_title: evidence(282): correct landedValidation timestamp and record after-arm c=100 samples

head_commit.message:
evidence(282): correct landedValidation timestamp and record after-arm c=100 samples

- landedValidation previously recorded `enqueuedAt: 2026-11-21T05:12:32Z`.
  That value is the committer.date of the resulting merge commit 1c9cdc11,
  not the queue entry time. The queue entry time was never observed, so the
  field is removed and the facts are split into dispatchedBeforeApply (#300)
  and afterApply (#302).
- after arm (c=100) now has n=3 natural samples: #302 wall 385.0s, #299 462.0s,
  #303 438.0s; max per-job queue wait 14.0s / 49.0s / 16.0s.
- throughput ceiling test: consecutive landing gaps 424s and 478s are both
  shorter than the c=1 wall p50 (496.0s). Under c=1 merge groups are
  serialized, so each gap has a lower bound of one wall time. Both gaps are
  therefore structurally impossible under c=1 - a bound that holds regardless
  of sample size.
- burst rate 3 landings / 902s = 11.97 merges/h vs c=1 ceiling 7.258/h. The
  burst is a backlog drain, so it is not generalized to sustained throughput.
- n=3 < 5, so no p50/p95 is declared for the c=100 arm.
